purpose: Measure exact cross-native-session WebFetch operation overlap in the full pinned SALT-NLP/SWE-chat conversations table, using only native session identity and the already-frozen conservative URL+prompt operation identity.

population.reason_no_agent_filter: Tool identity is exact WebFetch; do not introduce a post-source agent subset unless separately preregistered.

native_coordinates.duplicate_physical_key_policy: If duplicate physical keys have byte-equivalent parsed tool input JSON, retain one physical call and count removed duplicates; if payloads disagree, fail closed.

operation_identity.url: trim; Node WHATWG URL parse; require http/https; remove fragment; lowercase protocol/hostname through WHATWG serialization; serialize with URL.toString()
operation_identity.prompt: CRLF/CR to LF, then trim; must remain nonempty

metrics.cross_session_exact_reuse_opportunities: A call counts when the same exact operation key has appeared previously in at least one different native session.

consequences.LOW_EXACT_OVERLAP_SIGNAL: Do not commission authoritative browser replay from this source; retain as negative evidence for exact browser-operation reuse under this identity.
consequences.WEAK_EXACT_OVERLAP_SIGNAL: Only a separate preregistered authoritative replay/materiality study may follow.
consequences.STRONG_EXACT_OVERLAP_SIGNAL: Only a separate preregistered authoritative replay/materiality study may follow.
consequences.INSUFFICIENT_EXTERNAL_SAMPLE: Seek a different disjoint natural source; do not pool overlapping subsets post hoc.
consequences.any_result: Does not pass PRIVATE285, prove observer independence, authorize SeenRelay reuse, change Production, or authorize population/commercial claims.
